{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Bread|Bread]]

==Ingredients==
*Soft [[Cookbook:Baguette|baguette]] or French [[Cookbook:Bread|bread loaf]]
*1 stick (¼ [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] or a bit over 100 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
*3 cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], peeled

==Procedure==
# Place oven rack to middle setting, and preheat to 350°F (175°C).
# Using a [[Cookbook:Bread Knife|bread knife]], cut baguette in half lengthwise, then cut diagonal slits towards the bottom but not all the way through.
# With a garlic crusher or [[Cookbook:Chef's Knife|chef's knife]], [[Cookbook:Mincing|mince]] the peeled garlic cloves.
# In a medium bowl, soften butter in a microwave. The time will depend on the microwave.
# With a fork, mash minced garlic into softened butter, and mix until even.
# With a [[Cookbook:Butter Knife|butter knife]], spread butter mix onto both halves of bread and in the diagonal slits.
# Wrap each half with [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|foil]], and place in oven on middle rack. [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 15–20 minutes.
# Remove bread from oven, remove foil, and serve warm.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* If you're a garlic lover, add one or more cloves of garlic and/or additional [[Cookbook:Garlic Powder|garlic powder]].
